message: みんなを守るために

name: Synn
message: 「How's that? Right around here?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, that's the spot~~」

name: Synn
message: 「A plushie getting sore muscles? That's impossible.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't lump me in with you young'uns. Ah, right there, that's good~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, you pushed yourself until you ended up like this. Thanks.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Had to, or we'd have been done for.」
It must have hit him a day late. Though I can't talk--I was so exhausted last night I passed right out.

name: Paqy
message: 「What's wrong?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm so pathetic. Struggling that much against such a little girl...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Size ain't proportional to strength. After all, I'm pretty strong myself, despite how I look!!」

name: Synn
message: 「If it were just her, that'd be one thing, but apparently there's even some strongest demon named Bylous out there... Even though I might be the weakest Demon Lord ever.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You were living as an ordinary human up until just the other day. That's just how it goes.」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaargh. That's not good enough, I tell you! I have to get stronger!」

name: Paqy
message: 「What's gotten into you all of a sudden?」

name: Synn
message: 「If I take my sweet time, I'm gonna get beaten to a pulp! And if that's gonna happen, I have no choice but to act before it does!」

name: Paqy
message: 「So, what're you gonna do?」

name: Synn
message: 「No matter how much I complain or hate it, I can't change the fact that I'm the Demon Lord.」

name: Synn
message: 「In that case, I want to become a Demon Lord that everyone acknowledges even more.」

name: Synn
message: 「And to do that, I have to get stronger...! Alri~ght. I don't know what I should do, but for now, let's do this!」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's the spirit.」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Alri~ght. First, I'm gonna become a Demon Lord who surpasses Dad~~!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Is that right, is that right? Surpass the previous Demon Lord, he says...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Aaaahhhh!!」

name: Synn
message: 「What's wrong?」
Paqy slowly pulls out a cigar.

name: Paqy
message: 「Dammit! Dammit! It won't light!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tch, guess I'll just make do with this.」
Saying that, he stuck a straw into his mouth.

name: Paqy
message: 「Whew... Now this is what you call a grown-up taste.」

name: Synn
message: 「First off, this is a no-smoking area. And what was that reaction just now?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hmph... I see. The Demon Lord's gone and grown up without me even realizing it.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Which means, you've finally hardened your resolve that much, huh.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, trying to dodge the question isn't gonna work.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Looks like the time has finally come to hand this over.」

name: Synn
message: 「Stop stalling and tell me already.」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's an item the previous Demon Lord told me not to hand over until you'd steeled your resolve.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh...! What!? There's a surprise like that!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Which means the time to unleash that so-called seal has finally arrived!!」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Ooh~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait a sec. After all that grandstanding, weren't you just failing to remember something?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gah!」

name: Synn
message: 「You actually forgot, didn't you?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Dammit! Dammit! The flint's busted!」
Pulling out a smoke when he doesn't even usually smoke--he must be pretty flustered.
Still, without Paqy around, I never would have found out about this in the first place.

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks, Paqy. For remembering.」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'm telling you, I had it ready for when the day came!」

name: Synn
message: 「Honestly, you're never straightforward...」
I hold down the letter from Dad with a ruler and slice open the seal.

name: Synn
message: 「'How to Awaken the Demon Lord's Power'... ?」
Now that's a topic that really scratches an itch.

name: Synn
message: 「Let's see... 'Guts and willpower'」
Isn't that way too vague for such a promising start?

name: Paqy
message: 「Oh, right! That was the key!」

name: Synn
message: 「If that's all it takes to trigger it, wouldn't it be weird that I haven't manifested it by now?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Which is exactly why you need 'self-awareness'」

name: Synn
message: 「Self-awareness...?」

name: Paqy
message: 「When it comes down to it, My Lord, you don't actually wanna become the Demon Lord at all.」

name: Synn
message: 「Urk. Well, I'm carrying the risk of sacrificing my sparkling high school life, after all.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ain't like it's 100% set in stone that'll happen, right? Even the Demon Lords in games have their good points.」

name: Synn
message: 「Like what?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Like how they wait around for the hero to level up and grow.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's just because they have lower back pain and can't move.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Still, My Lord. If you don't think of yourself as the Demon Lord, the power inside ya ain't gonna answer your call.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see, that makes sense. It really would be too selfish to rely on the Demon Lord's power only when it's convenient.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Alright, stuff's starting to come back to me!」

name: Synn
message: 「Really!? Tell me more, Paqy.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, leave it to me.」

name: Synn
message: 「A~lright, I'll go make some tea!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Sure, thanks.」

name: Synn
message: 「Here you go.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Sluuuurp.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Blegh, it's watered-down recycled tea leaves again...」

name: Synn
message: 「And then, and then?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Jeez, staring at me with those sparkling eyes...」

name: Synn
message: 「Keep going, keep going!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Remember how we talked about self-awareness earlier? The trigger to awaken your power is flipping a switch in your head.」

name: Synn
message: 「Flipping a switch...?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Calm your mind and picture yourself as the Demon Lord.」

name: Synn
message: 「A-alright...」

name: Synn
message: 「What in the world is going on!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yes! It appears to be a fierce assault from the hero's party!」

name: Synn
message: 「Bah, what happened to the Four Heavenly Kings!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「I believe they are already on their last breath!」

name: Synn
message: 「Heh heh heh... Not bad. So it's finally time for the Demon Lord to take the stage. Intercept them! I'll crush them myself!」

name: Paqy
message: 「At your command!」

name: Synn
message: 「Forth, to battle!」

name: Synn
message: 「...Nothing's happening.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ain't your mental image a little off?」
Actually, what even was that just now?

name: Synn
message: 「A-alright. This time for sure... Starting today, I'm going to become the Demon Lord!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!! An earthquake!!」
Suddenly, the floor of the room began to shake.

name: Synn
message: 「And a typhoon on top of it!? This is bad!!」
A whirlwind kicked up with me at its center.

name: Synn
message: 「Wh-what is this...!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Looks like a glimpse of it already showed up.」
Paqy answered while floating in the wind, plastered against the ceiling.

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!! Could this be the power of the Demon Lord...」

name: Paqy
message: 「You bet it is.」

name: Synn
message: 「Amazing!!」
Power surges and overflows from every inch of my body.

name: Synn
message: 「What happens if I use Spirit Arts here?」

name: Paqy
message: 「The house'll get blown to bits.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」
The moment I let out a light sigh--
All the strength drained right out of my body.

name: Synn
message: 「Ah... ahh~~」
I can't even put any strength into my legs or hips.

name: Synn
message: 「Haah... haah... What was that just now? All I did was take a quick breather.」

name: Paqy
message: 「It ending the second you let your guard down is proof you ain't used to it yet.」

name: Synn
message: 「Haah, haah... Man, this is exhausting~~!」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's why you need guts and willpower to keep Fever Time going longer.」

name: Synn
message: 「I get it... Becoming a Demon Lord is easy, so I have to work hard to master the power...」

name: Paqy
message: 「It ain't gonna be a walk in the park.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's tough, sure, but with this I might actually be able to go toe-to-toe with Bylous. In that case, I've got no choice but to do it!」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's the spirit!!」

name: Synn
message: 「You said it!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Though, Demon Lord. Hate to rain on your parade, but...」

name: Paqy
message: 「As long as you're hiding the fact that you're a Demon Lord, you can only use that power where nobody'll find out, ya know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Why? Can't I just use it secretly?」

name: Paqy
message: 「When it's that flashy, no way. Besides, I doubt you noticed, Synn-sama, but your hair color changed.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaat!? It'd be bad news if the Student Council President went around bleaching his hair!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's kinda like a side effect from turning into a Demon Lord. Well, it's temporary, so don't sweat it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, if that happens... Then yeah, in front of everyone, they'd know something was up at a single glance...」

name: Synn
message: 「Hold on!? Couldn't I just use the Demon Lord's power to drive the demons away before anyone finds out?」

name: Synn
message: 「If I do that, I'll still be able to enjoy a sparkling school life with everyone during the day!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, that's it. That has to be it! Hehehe, I'm gonna give it my all!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... You put on an innocent face, but there's no telling what you're doing behind the scenes. Deceiving people for your own benefit--that kind of thinking is worthy of a Demon Lord.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why do you always try to make me out to be so scheming?!」
Still, I've finally found a clue to solving this! The rest depends on my own hard work.

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy. I know I'm like this, but... it's so I can become a true Demon Lord. Will you help me?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, of course!!」
And so, my special training to become a true Demon Lord began.
I'm going to protect everyone with the power of the Demon Lord!
